conditions.displayName: The /health uptime check fails from at least 2 regions for 10 minutes

documentation.content:
https://galleryoftheday.youcanbeapirate.com/health answered with an error (or not at all). Open it in a browser: the body says why.

- `unavailable` or `degraded`: Turso is failing. Check Turso's status and the Cloud Run logs (search for "Loading the prompts failed"). The page keeps showing the cached copy for up to 7 days.
- `stale: the newest image is from <date>`: the daily run did not produce a day. Check the "Run R Scripts Daily" workflow in GitHub Actions (failed run? disabled after 60 days idle? OpenAI credits?).
- `empty`: the prompts table has no rows.
- No answer at all: the Cloud Run service or the domain mapping is down.

See DEPLOY.md in the repository.
